findings.title: U+0020 before : ; ? instead of U+202F
findings.note: fr.md (Punctuation & typography) requires espace fine insécable U+202F before : ; ! ?. 12 values use a plain U+0020, which also lets the line break before the mark. The sibling fr/ui.teamBridge.json uses U+202F in all 44 such positions. Suggested values swap only that one character.

findings.title: `public` badge gender
findings.note: The badge marks the COMMUNITY as public (context: 'Badge marking a community as public'; rendered beside the community-name chip in community-home.tsx:270). «communauté» is feminine, and the audited switcher badge ui.teamBridge.scope.community.public is already «Publique». es «Pública» and ru «Публичное» agree with their community noun.

findings.title: plural `many` arm omitted
findings.note: fr.md (Plurals) gives the pattern with a `many {# de …}` arm; 476 of 515 shipped fr plurals carry it, including the twins ui.teamBridge.replies.count and attachments.in_message. Without it an exact million renders «1 000 000 secondes». rail.unread is left alone because its words are adjectival («non lus» / «sin leer»), where `other` already reads correctly. Unreachable for these counts in practice, hence NIT.

findings.note: Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 21 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: vous register and infinitive actions per fr.md; « forfait Team » / « essai Team » keep 'Team' as the plan name (the shipped ui.teamBridgeTrial convention); « la Local Operator Community » article reads naturally; « Mio » is the correct French binary unit; « seuls l’équipe et les modérateurs » is accurate for a locked channel (community-model.ts: channel.locked → all_members_staff_post).
